$comment: Canonical list of industries/branches a visitor can select. Each use case references these by id in its industries array, so the library can be filtered to what's actually relevant for that industry.

industries.label: Retail & Consumer Goods
industries.description: Ecommerce, fashion, grocery, and other direct-to-consumer product brands across web, app, and store.

industries.label: Financial Services
industries.description: Banks, insurers, and fintechs personalizing around accounts, products, and financial goals.

industries.label: Telecom, Media & Technology
industries.description: Telecom operators, streaming/media platforms, and SaaS/tech companies with subscription or usage-based relationships.

industries.label: Travel & Hospitality
industries.description: Airlines, hotels, travel booking platforms, and leisure brands personalizing around trips and stays.

industries.label: Automotive & Manufacturing
industries.description: Automotive OEMs/dealers and manufacturers with direct customer relationships around purchase, ownership, and service.

industries.label: Healthcare, Public Sector & Utilities
industries.description: Healthcare providers/payers, government/public-sector services, and utility providers personalizing citizen or patient communication.
